posts.subject: suggestion for TTT
posts.bodyHtml:
I would like to suggest to change the " getting more health (HP) when you have more stamm points'' on TTT.

i know that we should give people who have a lot of stamm points some reward , but for example on the knife server people who have a lot of stamm points they get no fall damage and that is a good reward for people who have a lot of stamm and is not game breaking ,
I think we should change that for good ( my opinion )
#MakeDreamBetter

Hey,


I've talked to several of our admins/players about the issue.
We decided to reduce the hp-bonus to a maximum of 140 hp (20hp per level) to create a fairer system.


VIPs can now be one-hit killed by AWP (if you hit head/abdomen/pelvis) and backstabs again.
We acknowledge the fact that VIPs deserve a reward for their loyalty and long playtime but it is necessary to consider the p.o.v. of new players/players that do not have that much free time on their hands as well.


We'll see how the change works out and if the circumstances require will take further steps in order to balance gameplay.


Best regards


BlackFire
